watches.scope: Platform, release, upgrade, component and security observations
ES editions, capabilities, prerequisites, pairing and commercial scope
Provider, region, regulated availability and authorization scope
Independent cross-product audit and assessment coverage

publicationRule: Every supported new finding and actual scoped reassessment is part of the normal review output. Preserve original IDs, evidence and dates. Explicitly declare no-new-observations, pending-public-provenance or blocked outcomes; never manufacture records from labels or silence.
provenanceRule: Publish the audit first when an immutable public audit commit is needed; declare pending-public-provenance, then finish the feed follow-up before reporting the run fully delivered.
scheduleRule: Reuse the four existing watches without changing schedules, timing modes, enabled states or audience.
coverageRule: The twelve normalized findings are a historical baseline, not a cap or complete global coverage. Future supported findings may be added in the same contract.
